svg.title: Niro security data flow
svg.desc: Data flow between the customer-controlled Niro execution environment, customer-selected AI, authorized destinations, Git and CI services, and optional PostHog telemetry.
svg.text: Customer-controlled execution with explicit external data destinations
Direct connections under customer accounts and policy
Reads code; writes fixes in fix mode
Configured for the selected local CLIs
PR metadata, statuses, branches, and fixes
Scoped hosts, ports, and test accounts
Repository names, usage, and pentest results
Arrow direction indicates where data is sent.
